# Streaming & AI Unlock Check

> Free browser tool that checks, over the visitor's own connection and route, whether streaming and AI services are
> available and which country each one sees: ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Copilot, Grok, Perplexity, Le Chat, Poe, Character.AI, Meta AI, Netflix, Disney+, DAZN, Crunchyroll, Peacock, Philo, NBC, Shudder, beIN CONNECT, Twitch, Prime Video, Apple TV+, HBO Max, Hulu, Paramount+, Pluto TV, Tubi, ESPN+, Fubo, Viu, Viki, Bilibili TV, Spotify, Pandora, Deezer, SoundCloud, TikTok, YouTube, X, Instagram, Telegram, WhatsApp, Discord, Reddit, Facebook, Messenger, Threads, Signal, LINE, Snapchat, Pinterest, Google, Wikipedia, Roblox, KKTV, TVB Anywhere+, SBS On Demand, FOD, DMM TV, ZDF, BBC iPlayer, Mango TV, Tencent Video, Bilibili, iQIYI, Youku, NetEase Cloud Music. It uses each service's own
> region API where a page can read it, the service's own Cloudflare edge (/cdn-cgi/trace) against its published
> country list, redirect counting (Netflix's country pages, "unavailable" redirects), and marks inferred results.
> Everything runs client-side; no results are sent to the site.
